```{r}
## load in signature attribution to each branch branches attribution :
msa_branches<-read.csv('../Signatures/msa_phylogenetic_branches_attribution/pruned_attribution_paediatric_branches_SBS_abs_mutations.csv')%>%

crypt_pileup_sig_annotated<-read.csv('../Data/Main_Outputs/crypt_pileup_classification.csv')
```
# PERMUTATION ANALYSIS FOR PHYLOGENETIC TREES

## a : create permutation dataframe
```{r}
permutation_analysis_dataframe<-crypt_pileup_sig_annotated%>%
  mutate(SBS88_branch_positive=SBS88_branch>0) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, biopsy, crypt, branch.length,x,SBS88_branch_positive, background_muts_branch_start_msa,background_muts_branch_end_msa,age_background_muts_branch_start_msa, age_background_muts_branch_end_msa,age)
  
## retrieve list of crypts that demonstrated at least one break point
crypts_with_branch_point <- crypt_pileup_sig_annotated %>%
  filter(branch_status%in%c('Second positive branch','Post cessation branch','Post cessation branch - Indeterminant')) %>%# subset those crypts that have at least one branch point
  pull(unique(crypt))

## get list of crypts with at cessation :
crypts_demonstrating_cessation <- crypt_pileup_sig_annotated %>%
  filter(branch_status%in%c('Post cessation branch')) %>%# subset those crypts that have at least one branch point
  pull(unique(crypt))
  
```

## b : run permutation analysis :
```{r}
N_PERM <- 1000
set.seed(42)

get_stat <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(SBS88_branch_positive) %>%
    filter(!(branch.length < 50 & x < 50)) %>% # exclude truncal branches (start & end < 50 muts)
    #filter(round(age_background_muts_branch_end_msa, 3) != round(age, 3)) %>%           # exclude terminal branches
    group_by(patient, biopsy, crypt) %>%
    slice_min(age_background_muts_branch_start_msa, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(patient, biopsy, crypt,
           earliest_age_commencement = age_background_muts_branch_start_msa,
           latest_age_commencement   = age_background_muts_branch_end_msa)
}

# Observed: per-crypt earliest/latest, then summarise to per-patient medians
obs_df <- get_stat(permutation_analysis_dataframe[permutation_analysis_dataframe$crypt %in%crypts_with_branch_point,])

get_patient_medians <- function(stat_df) {
  stat_df %>%
    group_by(patient) %>%
    summarise(
      median_earliest = median(earliest_age_commencement, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_latest   = median(latest_age_commencement,   na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

obs_medians <- get_patient_medians(obs_df)
cat("Observed per-patient median earliest commencement ages:\n")
print(obs_medians)

N_PERM=1000
perm_results <- lapply(seq_len(N_PERM), function(i) {
  perm_data <- permutation_analysis_dataframe %>%
    filter(crypt %in% crypts_demonstrating_cessation) %>%
    group_by(crypt) %>%
    mutate(SBS88_branch_positive = sample(SBS88_branch_positive)) %>%
    ungroup()

  perm_df <- tryCatch(get_stat(perm_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(perm_df) || nrow(perm_df) == 0) return(NULL)
 
  perm_df %>% mutate(perm = i)
})

perm_all <- bind_rows(perm_results)
```

## d : compare age of timepoints 
```{r}
earliest_ks_result <- ks.test(obs_df$earliest_age_commencement, perm_all$earliest_age_commencement, alternative = "greater")
cat("\nKS test (observed earlier than null):\n")
print(earliest_ks_result)
```
```{r}
latest_ks_result <- ks.test(obs_df$latest_age_commencement, perm_all$latest_age_commencement, alternative = "greater")
cat("\nKS test (observed earlier than null):\n")
print(latest_ks_result)
```
## e : construct plots:
### i : construct plot for distribution of earliest ages of commencement
```{r}
perm_all<-perm_all%>%select(-perm)%>%mutate(distribution='perm')
obs_df<-obs_df%>%mutate(distribution='obs')
combined_distribution<-rbind(perm_all,obs_df)

earliest_dist_plt<-ggplot() +
  stat_ecdf(data = combined_distribution, aes(x = earliest_age_commencement,colour=distribution), linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(breaks=c('obs','perm'),
                      values=c('hotpink3','grey20'),
                      labels=c('Observed Distribution','Permutation Null Distribution'))+
  geom_vline(xintercept=median(combined_distribution[combined_distribution$distribution=='perm',]$earliest_age_commencement),
             linetype='dashed',colour='grey20')+
  geom_vline(xintercept=median(combined_distribution[combined_distribution$distribution=='obs',]$earliest_age_commencement),
             linetype='dashed',colour='hotpink3')+
  labs(
    title = "Observed earliest age of commencement vs permutation null distribution",
    x = "Age at earliest commencement of exposure (years)",
    y = "Cumulative proportion",
    colour='') +
  geom_text(aes(x=10,y=0,label='Kolmogorov Smirnov P-value < 0.001'),colour='black',size=4,hjust=0)+
  theme_classic()+
   theme(axis.title=element_text(size=14,face='bold'),
        legend.title=element_text(size=14,face='bold'),
        axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        legend.text=element_text(size=12),
        title=element_text(size=14,face='bold'),
        legend.position ='bottom'
        )
ggsave('../Supplementary_Figures/supplementary_figure_9_comparison_earliest_commencement_distribution.png',earliest_dist_plt,width=10,height=5,dpi=150)
```

### ii : construct plot for distribution of latest ages of commencement
```{r}
latest_dist_plt<-ggplot() +
  stat_ecdf(data = combined_distribution, aes(x = latest_age_commencement,colour=distribution), linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(breaks=c('obs','perm'),
                      values=c('hotpink3','grey20'),
                      labels=c('Observed Distribution','Permutation Null Distribution'))+
  geom_vline(xintercept=median(combined_distribution[combined_distribution$distribution=='perm',]$latest_age_commencement),
             linetype='dashed',colour='grey20')+
  geom_vline(xintercept=median(combined_distribution[combined_distribution$distribution=='obs',]$latest_age_commencement),
             linetype='dashed',colour='hotpink3')+
  labs(
    title = "Observed latest age of commencement vs permutation null distribution",
    x = "Age at latest possible commencement of exposure (years)",
    y = "Cumulative proportion",
    colour='') +
  geom_text(aes(x=10,y=0,label='Kolmogorov Smirnov P-value < 0.001'),colour='black',size=4,hjust=0)+
  theme_classic()+
   theme(axis.title=element_text(size=14,face='bold'),
        legend.title=element_text(size=14,face='bold'),
        axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        legend.text=element_text(size=12),
        title=element_text(size=14,face='bold'),
        legend.position ='bottom'
        )
ggsave('../Supplementary_Figures/supplementary_figure_9_comparison_latest_commencement_distribution.png',latest_dist_plt,width=10,height=5,dpi=150)
```
